1 #31437106v9<WNJDMS> - Ground Lease (Gilbane- URI Project)- Provident Draft 6-9-25 GROUND LEASE AGREEMENT This Ground Lease Agreement (“ Ground Lease”) is made and entered as of September [1], 2025 (“Effective Date”), by and between the UNIVERSITY OF RHODE ISLAND, a public institution of higher education established by the laws of the State of Rhode Island (“University”), for itself and on behalf of its governing board, the University of Rhode Island Board of Trustees, a public corporation created and established pursuant to Chapter 32, Title 16 of the General Laws of Rhode Island ( “Board of Trustees ” and, together with the University, collectively, the “Lessor”), and PRG – RI PROPERTIES LLC , a Rhode Island limited liability company (“Lessee”) whose sole member is PROVIDENT RESOURCES GROUP INC., a Georgia nonprofit corporation and a qualified tax -exempt charitable organization under Section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code (" Sole Member").
Lessor and Lessee are referred to herein as each, a “Party” and collectively, the “Parties”.
RECITALS: A.

The Board of Trustees operate the University on its (i) main campus consisting of approximately 1,200 acres located in Kingston, Rhode Island 02881 (“ Kingston Campus”); (ii) the Narragansett Bay Campus consisting of 165 acres located at 215 Sout h Ferry Road, Narragansett, Rhode Island 02882 (“ Narragansett Bay Campus ”); (iii) the W.
Alton Jones Campus, consisting of 2,300 acres, located in West Greenwich, Rhode Island, 02817 (with the Kingston Campus and Narragansett Bay Campus collectively, the “Campus”) that includes certain on-campus student housing residence halls, graduate apartment -style housing and other housing facilities located thereon (collectively, the “Housing System”).
B.
On April 30, 2024, Lessor issued a Request for Proposal for New Student Housing Project (“RFP”) to private qualified development firms to enter into a public -private partnership (“P3”) transaction with Lessor, pursuant to which Lessor would contribute a portion of land located on its [Kingston Campus] into the partnership to enhance its Housing System and to meet student demand (the “P3 Program”).
C.

Lessor has determined that it is in the best interest of the University and its students to proceed with the P3 Program’s objectives and capital projects as described in the RFP and to lease to Lessee the Property (as defined herein) for the purpose of Lessee developing, financing, designing, constructing, furnishing, equipping, operating, managing and maintaining the Student Housing Facilities (as defined herein) on the Property , for the benefit of the University and in furtherance of the P3 Program.
D.
The Parties agree to cooperate and work together to provide quality student housing communities for th e University’s students and affiliated persons who will reside in the Student Housing Facilities in a financially responsible and sustainable manner, upon the terms and conditions set forth in this Ground Lease.
NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual promise s herein contained and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and adequacy of which is hereby acknowledged, Lessor and Lessee mutually covenant and agree as follows:
